text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin comes away from the<n>Satsuki Sho
victorious. Her fierce<n>competitive spirit simply
proves to be<n>too much.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Biwa Hayahide can fill the gaps in<n>her
calculations, she can win. But no<n>matter what
solution she thinks up,<n>premonitions of defeat
plague her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is shaken. Beside<n>her, Winning
Ticket stays strong and<n>boldly declares her
intention to win<n>the Japanese Derby no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Can we rebuild Biwa Hayahide's<n>winning equation
in time for the<n>Derby, where the three of them will
meet once more?
